features: designed to fully use the potential of the 32-bit platform
embedded scripting runtime for Abacus 3.0 through its document API; standalone notebook and offline file editing remain available

portability_contract.shared_logic: Separate application/document algorithms from platform adapters.
portability_contract.display: Query dimensions and attributes; use semantic colors and clipping.
portability_contract.memory: Bounded buffers and handles for banked objects; report allocation failures.
portability_contract.storage: Versioned, explicitly encoded records; no persisted pointers or raw C structures.
portability_contract.migration: Recompile for the target, adapt OS-specific modules and test resource limits. This does not expand the listed supported platforms.

abacus_file_integration.model: Standalone mode: read/edit/write supported closed Abacus document files. Separate embedded mode in Abacus 3.0 is specified by technology.abacus_embedded_pulse.
abacus_file_integration.concurrency: Exclusive writer ownership. Do not edit a file concurrently in Pulse and Abacus.
abacus_file_integration.format_policy: Check format version and supported features before writing; reject unsupported edits without silently dropping data.
abacus_file_integration.save_policy: Write a replacement file, validate it, then perform a recoverable replacement retaining the prior version until success.
abacus_file_integration.formula_policy: Preserve formula text/encoding. Mark cached results invalid after edits; Abacus recalculates on opening unless Pulse has the matching evaluation library.
abacus_file_integration.memory_policy: Bounded record/cell iteration; whole-document duplication in RAM is not required.
abacus_file_integration.cross_version_policy: Each edition declares supported document-format versions. Later Artemis features are not implicitly writable by the Z80 edition.
